verdict.summary: Round 4 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The design remains explicit that v0.1 type erasure requires a closed GraphName representation plus fallible emission-time conversion, while compile-time rejection is limited to syntactic forms that necessarily yield invalid graph names. It preserves the accepted string-literal-to-NamedNode path and requires positive, negative, runtime-error, default-graph, cross-backend, and triple-byte-identity witnesses. The superseding status correction is internally consistent and does not overstate implementation: it clearly records that the upstream quad-emission patch is still future work. Findings are materially unchanged from round 3, so progress is stagnant.
